escape_asterisks off leaves asterisks in a table cell unescaped

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<table><tr><td>2*3 = 6</td></tr></table>", new ConversionOptions { EscapeAsterisks = false });
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
